summary: Scale-up plan metre: 3 kg CaCO3 over 0.05 m3; pressure EXCEEDS; uniformity 0.60; NH4-N 83966 mg/L [preliminary plan; stage gate BLOCKED]

findings.label: CALCULATED
findings.statement: scale metre: volume 0.05 m3, pore 0.020 m3, CaCO3 3.0 kg

findings.label: CALCULATED
findings.statement: pressure EXCEEDS: dP 9.44 bar vs allowable 5.00 bar

findings.label: CALCULATED
findings.statement: uniformity 0.60 (moderately heterogeneous — zoning/flux control advised); inlet clogging MEDIUM

findings.label: INFERRED
findings.statement: produced NH4-N in porewater 83966 mg/L exceeds site limit 50 mg/L — effluent treatment / dilution / struvite recovery is REQUIRED before discharge.

findings.label: INFERRED
findings.statement: scale penalty 0.15 (uniformity degrades with scale — VP2010)

findings.label: INFERRED
findings.statement: gate block: pressure exceeds allowable at metre scale

assumptions.label: INFERRED
assumptions.statement: conversion_efficiency design default 0.5 unless provided; VP2010 reports ~0.12 in a 1 m3 box — pilot must verify

assumptions.label: INFERRED
assumptions.statement: overburden assumed saturated bulk density 2000 kg/m3; fracture pressure = 2x overburden (classic borehole criterion); safe limit = 80% of fracture (OEGG 2017)

assumptions.label: INFERRED
assumptions.statement: bacteria suspension volume assumed 0.5 PV (Gomez 2017 used 0.5 PV injection)

assumptions.label: REPORTED
assumptions.statement: uniformity degrades with scale; lab uniformity is NOT representative (VP2010 m3 box)

evidence_used: VP2010 van Paassen 2010 (scale-up data, conversion, gradient<1)
GA2017/GA2018 Gomez et al. (0.5 PV, Vs detection)

rows.notes: AS2013: 0.5 M optimum; >0.75 M risks clogging and lower UCS
paired with urea 1:1 (stoichiometry); concentration window applies
mass requirements and solution volumes scale linearly with pore volume
PV count is dimensionless; keep the same PV per round across scales
conserve pore velocity; flow rate then scales with cross-sectional area
Q = v_pore * A * phi; NOT constant — re-derive per geometry
rounds depend on retention time vs ureolysis rate at the target length — recompute, do not reuse the lab count
VP2010 kept gradient < 1 in the 5 m column; gradient grows with path length for fixed velocity — the binding constraint is pressure
dP grows with path length / k; cap at ~80% fracture pressure (OEGG 2017)
VP2010 m3 box: 12% conversion, CaCO3 in corners/bottom; plan zoning + monitoring, do not expect lab uniformity

non_scalable_factors.reason: AS2013: 0.5 M optimum, >0.75 M reduces strength ~50% and clogs; concentration is a chemical design variable, not a volume fraction.
non_scalable_factors.action: keep at lab-validated concentration window; verify at pilot before any change

non_scalable_factors.reason: reaction-transport balance (Pe, Da) must be preserved; scaling velocity by volume changes regime.
non_scalable_factors.action: conserve pore velocity; scale only flow rate with cross-section

non_scalable_factors.reason: pressure rises with path length and falls with permeability; linearly scaling it invites hydrofracture.
non_scalable_factors.action: recompute from Darcy; cap at ~80% fracture pressure

non_scalable_factors.reason: rounds = f(residence time, ureolysis rate, target content); the lab count is specific to lab path length.
non_scalable_factors.action: recompute rounds from material balance + retention time

non_scalable_factors.reason: heterogeneity, preferential flow and clogging worsen monotonically with scale (VP2010).
non_scalable_factors.action: zone-based treatment, flux control, monitoring wells, Vs/CPT verification

warnings: produced NH4-N in porewater 83966 mg/L exceeds site limit 50 mg/L — effluent treatment / dilution / struvite recovery is REQUIRED before discharge.

notes: injection rate 30.0 L/min is outside the practical 5-15 L/min field range (OEGG 2017); field pumps may not deliver this uniformly.
constant-flux boundary: as clogging builds, pressure rises for fixed rate; monitor inlet pressure closely (inlet clogging is the classic MICP failure mode, VP2010).
Draft layout only — final borehole positions require geotechnical engineer sign-off (field gate).
Extraction wells balance flow and pull treatment through low-k layers.
Zone-based injection (packers / perforated intervals) is recommended for heterogeneous profiles (clogging_risk.preferential_flow_risk).

phases.note: flush to recover residual ammonium and unreacted reagents

notes: durations are estimates from total volume / design flow; confirm at pilot
sequential bacteria -> cementation prevents mixed-flocculation clogging (VP2010)

parameters.name: injection_pressure
parameters.alarm: reduce rate / pause phase
parameters.stop_rule: STOP if pressure > allowable (or >80% fracture pressure)
parameters.data_save: raw + 1 min rolling mean to datalogger; CSV + cloud backup

parameters.name: flow_rate
parameters.alarm: flow imbalance between inject/extract -> possible surface breakout
parameters.stop_rule: STOP if injection/extraction imbalance > 20% sustained

parameters.name: cumulative_volume
parameters.alarm: compare against planned phase volume
parameters.stop_rule: STOP phase at planned volume (volume-limited rounds)

parameters.name: pH
parameters.alarm: pH rise >9.5 indicates active ureolysis; drop <6.5 probe fault
parameters.stop_rule: STOP if pH < 6.0 or > 10.0 (probe check / dosing fault)

parameters.name: EC
parameters.alarm: sudden EC jump = precipitation front; steady decline = reagent exhaustion
parameters.stop_rule: no hard stop; trend-based advisory
parameters.data_save: EC log + correlation with Ca/urea samples

parameters.name: temperature
parameters.alarm: out of ureolysis-active window slows kinetics
parameters.stop_rule: STOP if <2 C or >45 C (kinetics/equipment)

parameters.name: ca_conc
parameters.alarm: Ca breakthrough at monitoring well = front arrival
parameters.stop_rule: advisory: adjust rounds based on Ca depletion profile

parameters.name: nh4_conc
parameters.alarm: near discharge limit -> route to treatment
parameters.stop_rule: STOP injection if effluent NH4-N > site limit (ammonia gate)
parameters.data_save: effluent sample log + mass balance of NH4-N

parameters.name: urea_conc
parameters.alarm: unreacted urea in effluent = low conversion
parameters.stop_rule: advisory: increase retention time

parameters.name: tracer
parameters.frequency: one pulse at start + breakthrough sampling
parameters.alarm: early breakthrough / low recovery = preferential flow
parameters.stop_rule: advisory: re-zone treatment if recovery < 70%

parameters.name: shear_wave_velocity
parameters.alarm: Vs gain < expected = poor cementation progress
parameters.stop_rule: advisory: additional rounds if Vs gain lags plan

parameters.name: groundwater_indicators
parameters.alarm: off-site plume detection
parameters.stop_rule: STOP and contain if groundwater indicator exceeds baseline

sampling_schedule.during_injection: pressure/flow continuous; pH/EC/温度 every 15 min; chemistry grab per round
sampling_schedule.post_treatment: core sampling + Vs + CPT at 7/28/90 days; groundwater recovery monitoring until NH4-N < limit

data_management.storage: datalogger CSV + cloud backup; immutable append-only (SHA-256 chain per project convention)
data_management.audit: calibration log per instrument; chain-of-custody for samples

drivers: scale penalty 0.15 (uniformity degrades with scale — VP2010)
mitigations: reduce injection rate / use pulsed injection to lower peak gradient

blocked_reasons: pressure exceeds allowable at metre scale

stop_conditions.action: stop injection, bleed pressure, investigate clogging, re-zone
stop injection, route effluent to treatment/struvite recovery

fallback_plan.trigger: any stop condition or gate failure
actions: halt injection and bleed injection pressure slowly
recover and treat effluent (NH4-N) before discharge
re-zone treatment: packers, per-layer intervals, balanced extraction
if clogged at inlet: shorten treatment path, add wells, alternate bacteria/cementation (sequential, VP2010)
escalate to geotechnical engineer + controller; never restart without re-evaluation
